@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import ascii_escaped
+
+
+def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate a record and return its normalized fields and diagnostic display."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must contain a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": ascii_escaped(value) if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)) else value,
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_pytest_escape/steps.py b/src/reusebench_pytest_escape/steps.py
index 3a948d4..7e1d0ea 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_pytest_escape/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_pytest_escape/steps.py
@@ -23,3 +23,20 @@ def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
         "display": ascii_escaped(value) if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)) else value,
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare an ordered batch with unique normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    seen = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: Any) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
+    """Group enabled displays by the first character of the normalized key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(left: Any, right: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Overlay prepared right records without moving existing keys."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    merged.update((item["key"], item) for item in batch(right))
+    return list(merged.values())
